login_subtitle: Connect Lymic to your Immich server so your photos and memories are always kept safe.
api_key_help_creation: In Immich, create an API key under Account Settings -> API Keys.
api_key_help_permission_user_read: verify the signed-in account during login
api_key_help_permission_album_read: view existing albums for target album selection
api_key_help_permission_album_create: create new target albums directly from the app
api_key_help_permission_album_update: add synchronized media to target albums
cloudflare_access_pair_required: Provide both Cloudflare Access client ID and client secret.
allow_local_http_description: HTTP exposes your API key. It works only with localhost and loopback addresses.
local_http_not_allowed: HTTP is allowed only for localhost and loopback addresses. All other servers require HTTPS.
sync_requires_folder: Select at least one folder first to start syncing.
autostart_subtitle: Start Lymic automatically in the background at system launch to back up new photos right away.
appearance_subtitle: Customize the visual appearance of Lymic.
upload_parallelism_subtitle: Choose how many files can upload to your server at the same time.
logout_confirmation: Do you really want to log out?
target_album_modal_subtitle: Select an optional Immich album for "{folder}"
target_album_none_description: Media will be synchronized to the root library
remove_folder_confirmation: Do you really want to remove this folder?
remove_folder_sync_warning: Syncing this folder is in progress. Removing it will cancel active uploads and discard all pending transfers for this folder. Files already uploaded remain on the server. Remove the folder?
notification_complete_body: {processed} files checked: {uploaded} newly backed up, {failed} failed.
sync_paused_hint: Your queue will resume right where it was paused.
update_check_subtitle: Check whether a new version of Lymic is available.
update_install_failed: The update could not be installed. You can try again.
update_sync_blocked: Finish or resume and complete synchronization before installing this update.
log_sync_already_in_progress: Manual sync already in progress. Ignoring request.
log_sync_queued_waiting: Sync queued, waiting for running synchronization.
log_upload_persistence_reconciled: Remote upload succeeded and local state persistence was reconciled.
log_bulk_check_cannot_retry: Bulk check cannot be retried; aborting sync: {error}
log_bulk_check_failed_max_attempts: Bulk check failed after {attempts} attempts; aborting sync: {error}
log_bulk_check_retry: Bulk check attempt {attempt}/{max} failed: {error}. Retrying in {seconds} seconds.
log_watcher_undo_failed: Could not undo watcher registration for ''{folder}'': {error}
log_folder_deferred: Folder ''{folder}'' does not exist; watching deferred until it appears.
log_watcher_restore_failed: Could not restore watcher registration for ''{folder}'': {error}
log_tray_refresh_after_remove_failed: Folder was removed, but could not refresh tray sync availability: {error}
log_tray_refresh_failed: Could not refresh tray sync state: {error}
log_folder_offline_startup: Folder ''{folder}'' offline at startup; watching deferred.
log_load_deferred_folders_failed: Could not load deferred watched folders: {error}
log_check_deferred_folders_failed: Could not check deferred watched folders: {error}
log_load_folders_for_startup_sync_failed: Could not load watched folders for startup sync: {error}
log_watcher_queue_overflow: File watcher event queue overflowed; reconciling all watched folders.
log_reconcile_after_event_loss_failed: Could not reconcile watched folders after event loss: {error}
log_skipping_overlapping_folder: Skipping overlapping watched folder ''{folder}'' because ''{parent}'' is already scanned.
log_database_repaired_notice: Database could not be used ({reason}). It was backed up to ''{backup}'' and rebuilt; restored {count} watched folder(s). Other stored app data could not be restored.
log_upload_persistence_reconcile_failed: Remote upload succeeded, but local state persistence could not be reconciled: {error}
folder_exclusions_help: Add a relative pattern. Use * within a segment and ** across folders.
folder_exclusions_invalid_pattern: Use a relative pattern with names, * and ** only.
folder_exclusions_all_warning: This rule set excludes all media in this Watched Folder.
